title: isabella-martin-evals-quality-scratchpad-2026-03-26
content:
Purpose: ad-hoc notes for small eval pass on conversational summarization workload (internal customer POC).

Context:
- Quick local runs against redwood/ri-3b-quant and a hosted fallback (redwood-hosted/ri-3b). Small prompt set (30 examples) focused on: factuality, omission, hallucination, and brevity.
- Observed a potential regression in recent serving-runtime commit (gh:ri/serving-runtime#412) that may affect token repetition for longer contexts. Filed JIRA: JIRA-RI-8421.

Quick rubric (ad-hoc; 1-4 scale but using labels):
- Correctness: Good / Minor error / Incorrect
- Completeness: Complete / Partial / Missing key points
- Hallucination: None / Minor (one unsupported claim) / Major (fabricated entity)
- Style/Verbosity: Concise / Slightly verbose / Verbose
- Formatting: Proper bullets / Runs-on / Broken JSON (when asked for structured)

Examples + notes (sample prompt -> outputs):
1) Prompt: "Summarize the following customer conversation into a 3-bullet action summary (who, what, next steps): [conversation A]"
- Model: redwood/ri-3b-quant (local)
- Output (good run):
  • Customer (Acme) needs refund for incorrect invoice (who).
  • Root cause: billing pipeline applied legacy tax rule (what).
  • Next steps: finance to issue refund by 2026-04-01, notify customer, add test to billing CI (next steps).
- Eval: Correctness = Good, Completeness = Complete, Hallucination = None, Style = Concise

- Output (bad run observed 2026-03-24):
  • Customer (Acme) requested refund (who).
  • Cause: payment gateway outage (what).
  • Next: escalate to infra + refund (next steps).
- Eval: Correctness = Incorrect (fabricated cause), Hallucination = Major -> matches regression note (JIRA-RI-8421) where KV cache misalignment seemed to insert prior-cached context which sometimes leads to mixing unrelated facts.

2) Prompt: "Return JSON {customer:..., actions:[...]} for convo B" (structured output)
- Model: redwood-hosted/ri-3b (v2026-03-18)
- Output: valid JSON but with trailing commas and a duplicated action entry.
- Eval: Formatting = Broken JSON (small), Style = Slightly verbose; Completeness = Partial
- Note: We should try adding stricter format-checking in post-process or a small output verifier. Possible guard: if parse fails, request -> regenerate with temperature=0.0 and 'format: strict' system instruction.

Regression observations:
- 2026-03-24 regression spike in hallucination rate on convo summarization test set (+14% hallucination compared to baseline from 2026-03-10). Correlated with rollout of serving-runtime patch (gh:ri/serving-runtime#412).
- Repro steps: run eval harness locally against ri-3b-quant and compare to hosted reference (v2026-03-18). Reproduced ~9/10 times with same seed.
- Hypothesis: KV cache sharding change introduced occasional context contamination for long histories (>1024 tokens). See JIRA-RI-8421 for logs and sampled tensors.

Quick experiments to run (next 48h):
- A) Re-run 100 samples with longer histories, logging token-level attention maps (if possible) to confirm cross-example leakage. Tag: gh:ri/debug-kv-cache.
- B) Evaluate with KV-cache disabled (runtime flag) to measure delta in hallucination/duplication.
- C) Try forcing temperature=0 and top_p=0.95 to see if deterministic decoding reduces fabricated facts.
- D) Run hosted vs dedicated (redwood-dedicated/ri-3b) to check if difference is infra-related.

Quick checklist for follow-up notes:
- [ ] Attach failing examples to JIRA-RI-8421 (done: 8 examples attached, need more diverse contexts).
- [ ] Add structured-output verifier to post-process pipeline (small script).
- [ ] Sync with serving-runtime on potential rollback window; propose gating rollout with canary traffic.
- [ ] Add a unit test in eval harness that flags >5% hallucination regression compared to pinned baseline.

Loose ideas / heuristics for scoring in quick eval harness (informal):
- If hallucination > 1 claim per example => mark as FAIL for factuality.
- If any fabricated entity (person/org) appears in summary => downgrade Correctness by 1 tier.
- If expected keys missing in structured output => auto-fail formatting test.

Random notes to self:
- Chat with Sam about whether we can log per-token KV IDs to S3 for debug (privacy ok for synthetic set).
- Maya will try running the same prompt-set with a 7b variant to measure whether larger model reduces hallucination (Maya to report by 2026-03-28).
- Keep eval set small but diverse: finance, legal, product support conversations.

References / links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/ri-evals
- JIRA: JIRA-RI-8421 (regression KV-cache)
- GH PR: gh:ri/serving-runtime#412

Immediate next steps (today):
1) Push a small job to run experiment B (KV-cache disabled) on 50 samples. Note: low cost; can use dev-gpu-1.
2) Add simple JSON parse check to eval harness and rerun on current baseline.
3) Schedule 30-min sync with runtime team (Sam + Ben) tomorrow to review traces.

End of scratchpad.

-- Isabella
